snippet.title: BONEYARD BOUNCE! // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/5094470/BONEYARD_BOUNCE

All four edges of the board are your paddle — a block breaker unfolded in four directions. Fire a spell-ball into a monster-packed graveyard maze and watch it carom through the horde. Elemental kills chain-detonate straight through walls. Smash the headstones too; the landlord pays for wreckage.

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: Studio JKMR aka @StudioJKMR 
📚 Publisher: Studio JKMR aka @StudioJKMR 
📅 Release Date: Nov 6, 2026
🎯 Genre: Action, Casual, Indie

AI Generated Content Disclosure
The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this: Generative AI is used to create the base designs and rough concepts for monsters and visual assets in the game.
